title: Enhancing resilience of distributed DC microgrids against cyber attacks using a transformer-based Kalman filter estimator.
summary: The transformer/Kalman-filter estimator is tested in simulated DC microgrid attack/delay scenarios; it improves signal/state estimation and tracking versus classical estimator baselines. This is a simulation-based result for a specific microgrid control question, with no operational attack detail reproduced and no field deployment claimed. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
